_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes match the level of the lowest of the 5 instructors and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP. A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level.
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

recommendations.what: Fix the weak link in your key lineups: Amane
recommendations.why: Amane is Lv 46 with 270,310 power and an empty chest slot, yet she sits in Arena attack, Arena defense, Barricade 1 and the Att march.
evidence: hero.md: Amane Lv 46, 270,310 power, chest slot empty
lineups.md: Arena attack, Arena defense, Barricade 1, Att

recommendations.what: Fill the 7 empty Drill Camp slots, reset the slotted heroes, and put the refunded Hero XP into the lowest instructor
recommendations.why: 7 slots are open and 10 heroes are not instructors. Slotting Amane and Helga (Lv 46) would raise them to 49 at no XP cost. Saul (Lv 50) is above the instructors, so don't slot him.
evidence: Drill Camp screen, 19 Oct: 7 open slots, all instructors Lv 49
recommendations.cost: No XP to slot (per community rule)

recommendations.what: Fill 1 empty chest slot and upgrade 10 pieces still at +0
recommendations.why: Amane's chest slot is empty. +0 pieces on Amane (2), Olive (2), Fahd (2), Yeonwoo (1), Edwin (1), Saul (1, Epic) and Helga (1, Epic).

recommendations.what: Check whether Fahd's and Amane's skills can be upgraded right now
recommendations.why: Fahd and Amane show 34/30 Epic manuals.
recommendations.note: Probably an old reading: Gordon's latest skill screen shows 6 Epic Expedition Manuals.

recommendations.what: Finish the promotions that are a few shards away
recommendations.why: Forrest is 4 shards from T4, Helga 5 from T1, Howard 6, Edwin 7, and Saul 14 from 2★ (unlocks 2 skills).
recommendations.note: Verified from data; where to get the shards is not recorded.

recommendations.what: Take Jabel out of either Be or Att
recommendations.why: Jabel is in both presets, so those two marches can't run at the same time.
evidence: lineups.md: Be (Diana, Jabel, Forrest), Att (Howard, Jabel, Amane)
recommendations.note: Rests on the community rule that a hero can be in only one march at a time.

recommendations.what: Consider moving Seth's full Epic infantry set
recommendations.why: Seth is a Rare economy hero holding a full Epic set. Check whether it would serve more on Howard or Helga.
evidence: hero.md: Seth gear power 137,700, full Epic set
